label: PAX7::FOXO1

sections.text: PAX7 encodes a paired-box transcription factor involved in skeletal-muscle progenitor development.
FOXO1 encodes a forkhead transcription factor involved in metabolism, differentiation and cell survival.
The fusion combines paired-box DNA binding with the FOXO1 transactivation region, generating a potent abnormal transcription factor that drives fusion-positive rhabdomyosarcoma.
PAX7::FOXO1-positive disease has shown better outcomes than PAX3::FOXO1-positive disease in some cohorts; the adverse associations of the two partners are not identical.
